_readme: Wikipedia insource sweep (scripts/wikipedia-insource.py): every article whose source mentions the configured phrases, with the sentences that mention it; is_company from the infobox; in_base/in_excluded resolved against the investor's rows. Candidates = company articles not in the base; the judge cites the article and its underlying reference.

articles.title: Heart Aerospace
categories: Aircraft manufacturers of the United States
Manufacturing companies based in Los Angeles
sentences: == Financing == In the spring of 2019, after participating in Y Combinator, Heart Aerospace raised US$2.1 million in seed funding led by EQT Ventures, the Norrsken Foundation, and Chris Sacca’s Lowercarbon Capital.

The company secured $35 million in Series A funding in July 2021, led by Bill Gates' Breakthrough Energy Ventures, United Airlines Ventures, and Mesa Air Group, with participation from existing seed investors EQT Ventures and Lowercarbon Capital.

Investors included the European Innovation Council Fund and Sagitta Ventures, a Danish early-stage investment firm, as well as some returning investors like Air Canada, Breakthrough Energy Ventures, EQT Ventures, Lowercarbon Capital, Norrsken VC, United Airlines, and Y Combinator.
